verdict.rationale: The evidence shows lead-to-order sales tracking, Copilot queries about pipeline updates, and configurable fields, dashboards, and views. None of it documents a visual pipeline or kanban board, customizable pipeline stages, or drag-and-drop deal updates. These are related CRM features rather than the capability the story asks for, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track deals on a visual pipeline with customizable stages and drag-and-drop updates
